methodological_authority.method_reused: dimensionally explicit representation/cancellation-floor diagnosis from internal failed Reference state
methodological_authority.important_difference: P2E07 diagnosed a local compartment residual. D3 prospectively extends the same logic to the domain-summed total residual; no local floor is promoted directly to a total tolerance.

purpose: Determine whether the remaining D1/D2 total-balance-only retries are numerically distinguishable from a prospectively defined total-domain representation/cancellation floor, without changing any solver tolerance.

matrix.policy: same invariant-integrated balance-rate scaling as D1/D2

total_residual_reconstruction.closure_requirement: Report absolute closure. A diagnostic state is floor-interpretable only when closure <= estimated_total_floor.

total_floor_definition.higher_precision_recomposition_differenc: abs(real64 native-order four-component sum - real128 four-component sum)
total_floor_definition.real64_summation_order_spread: max-min across all 24 permutations of the four total-domain components
total_floor_definition.rationale: This is the direct domain-summed analogue of the preregistered P2E07 floor construction and is defined before D3 execution.
total_floor_definition.boundary: The estimated total floor is a diagnostic numerical-resolution scale, not a rigorous propagated-error bound and not a new convergence tolerance.

hypotheses.H_total_validity: Some or all D2 total-only retry states have estimated_total_floor >= the configured total-balance tolerance.
hypotheses.H_total_residual_scale: Some or all D2 retry residuals are at or below the estimated_total_floor.
hypotheses.H_storage_resolution: The storage-input representation term is a material contributor to the total-domain floor; dominance is an outcome, not an assumption.

outcome_policy.positive: If the strict total criterion is not numerically distinguishable and the retry residual lies within the estimated floor, record this as support for a later separately preregistered research-only Reference convergence-policy proposal.
outcome_policy.negative: If retry residuals remain numerically distinguishable above the estimated floor, REF-HIGH remains blocked; do not widen the floor or fit a tolerance to the failures.

forbidden: No direct promotion of P2E07 local floor into a total tolerance
No use as untouched primary solver-admission evidence
next_action_rule: Persist the total-balance floor result. Only a later preregistered workunit may propose a research-only REF-HIGH convergence policy, and that policy must be formula-derived rather than fitted to D3 exceedance ratios.
